items.headline: $ALPHA DeFi Protocol AlphaFi Winds Down After Oracle Error
items.summary: Sui-based AlphaFi is shutting down after an oracle error, disabling new deposits and loans. Slush users are urged to exit four strategies with immediate withdrawals.

items.headline: $ADA DEX Volume Explodes 148% in Just One Week
items.summary: Cardano's decentralized exchange volume surged 148% over the past week, signaling fresh onchain momentum for the $ADA ecosystem.

items.headline: $CRO Jumps 6% on Crypto.com CFTC Equity Perps Filing
items.summary: $CRO climbed 6% after Crypto.com filed with the CFTC to offer US equity perpetuals, expanding its derivatives ambitions.

items.headline: $ENA Expands USDe Backing Into bStocks & Equity Perps
items.summary: Ethena is adding Binance bStocks and equity perpetuals to the basis trade backing $USDe, pushing its delta-neutral strategy into equities.

items.headline: $BGB Shock: Bitget Confirms $387.5M Hot Wallet Breach
items.summary: Bitget raised its hack estimate to $387.5M as token accounting widened, with withdrawals still paused. The exchange says its User Protection Fund will cover losses.
